label: GAMEBOARD
comment: The like-or-unlike look of the rotation round (ALGEBRA.md #the-rows-against-nature (f); #the-hypotheses-under-their-own-names, The sign holder rotates the two-part record; HIGHLIGHTS.md, There is no sense), a GameBoard reading and no finding: every number of the nine worlds read by build_world.py, which writes the world files, lays their bodies with the generator (tools/pixel_mode.py, each body's sense) and writes the blind expectation file before any run. One chain of `length` Nodes (x open with the faces' layer one Node deep, y and z folded); two bodies of `quanta` quanta of the plane family `plane` (matter's pair as a plane), declared one Node each at `at`, 64 Links apart, laid rotating by the generator as whole bodies in the senses a world names (+1 and +1 like, +1 and -1 unlike); the universe `turning` (the rule's own rows, examples/events/rule.json, with the charge, the holder of the sign, at the level weight `level_weight` declaring the act `rotation`, and the charged family) for the like and the unlike worlds and for two single-body worlds, each body alone at its Node on the same chain (`at` of the world); `uncharged`, the same rows with the plane family reading no holder of the sign (its `reads` the two holders of the content alone, so that it neither reads nor sources the charge: the coupling nil by the declaration, the owner's decision of 2026-10-02 on the declaration's read; the holder's level weight 10^6 kept as the row's, under which the energy line admits no integer T, the row being read by no plane), for the world `uncharged_pair` (the same bodies laid the same way, since the holder enters no pace under the rotation and the lay does not read it) and for the same two single bodies alone; the three universes share one T, 36,000, the energy line's for the pair [4000, 6000] at the holder's level weight 100 and write weight 400 (E_h T num = k_w Gamma den: 100 x 36,000 x 4,000 = 400 x 6,000 x 6,000; the advisor's one line, k_w = 4 E_h at T = 36,000, which keeps the lays' amplitudes), the plain control's holder at the same two weights, so that the controls compare with the turned worlds. Three forces move the bodies beside their own spreading: the mutual pull of the binding holder and gravity, G, in every pair; the image force of the open faces on a charged body, I (a face reads 0, a grounded wall, so a body's own tent is steeper toward its nearer face and a body of either sense is drawn to it), in every body of a universe where the holder couples; and the mutual electric effect E, like apart and unlike together. The uncharged pair carries G and no I; a charged single body carries I and no G and an uncharged single body neither; so the neutral background of the two charged pairs is the uncharged pair's separation change plus the image force read on the single bodies, the charged singles' separation change less the uncharged singles', and a = like less that background and b = unlike less it are E and -E where the forces add; `plain`, the same rows at the act `pace`, for the two control worlds; no declared detector (the faces' layer reports what leaves); `ticks` intervals, the reading over `window`. The reading (tools/body_drift.py): the centroid of each body's share over its half of the chain (the share in the current's units at the paces of the read, GameBoard.share_of, the halves split midway between the two bodies' Nodes), exact fractions, labelled GAMEBOARD, at the window's ends; the separation (the second centroid less the first) and its change; the like world's and the unlike world's change against that background. The numbers: 64 Links apart the binding holder's well between the bodies is e^(-3.2) of its Node's, so the mutual attraction's collapse stays small over the run while the holder of the sign's tent on a chain keeps its slope at any distance (the first look's designs, 24 and 40 Links apart at the level weight 10 over 120 intervals, gave the blind's two signs with a collapse of 6.4 and 3.6 Links behind them and the like effect twice the unlike one, the holder's own angle at the body, about 0.05 per interval, being half the body's binding margin omega_0 - omega_b = 0.10,; the first look at the level weight 100 on this chain gave both charged pairs 1.2 Links further apart than the uncharged pair, the image force I, and both 2.4 to 4 Links closer than the charged single bodies, the mutual pull G: ENGINE.md, section 6); the level weight 100 holds that angle at a twentieth of the margin, and 400 intervals let the effect, which grows as the square of the time, stand above the spreading's asymmetry, which grows with the time. Under the energy line's integers of 2026-10-02 (turning.json at T 36,000 with the charge at the level weight 100 and the write weight 400, the coupling k_w / E_h = 4 where this design asked 0.01) the generator refuses `like` and `unlike` by the start's own rule: 'the lay and the rest of 2 holders and 1 signs finds no fixed point: the levels re-read return to an earlier state after 31 passes, a cycle of length 8, 12699 and -8253 at the Node [33, 0, 0] of the row 2' (the sign holder's rest at twice Gamma under the two bodies, the chain's tent without a sink); the two worlds stand declared without a mode file, which the loader refuses at load. Of the seven other worlds, laid before that round (the uncharged pair's re-lay at T 36,000 was still wandering after 54 rounds and was not taken; the single bodies and the plain controls were not re-laid), the three uncharged worlds start under the current integers (the GameBoard's start admits their lays within the gate's rounding) and are not re-read against the blind; the four charged looks are refused at the start under the current integers, by name: `like` and `unlike` as above, and the plain controls, whose lays of the earlier round the start refuses under plain.json's T 36,000, the charge at the level weight 100 and the write weight 400 and the magnitude read of the holder of the sign, `like_plain` by the start's own rule, 'the lay and the rest of 2 holders and 1 signs finds no fixed point: the levels re-read return to an earlier state after 7 passes, a cycle of length 4, 531 and 539 at the Node [87, 0, 0] of the row 1', and `unlike_plain` by the count gate, 'the body 0 declares the count 54 and its family's share reads 431 quanta at its Nodes at T = 36000: a declared count is within the rounding of the share in quanta, ((|c - read| - 1) div 2)^2 <= c'; the plain controls too stand declared without a mode file, which the loader refuses at load, and the plain control's reading of the two senses waits with them; the charged single bodies `alone_first` and `alone_second`, laid before the round, are refused at the start too under turning.json's integers and stand declared without a mode file as well: `alone_first`, 'the lay and the rest of 2 holders and 1 signs finds no fixed point: the levels re-read return to an earlier state after 20 passes, a cycle of length 4, -5053 and 10375 at the Node [33, 0, 0] of the row 2', and `alone_second`, 'the lay and the rest of 2 holders and 1 signs finds no fixed point: the levels re-read return to an earlier state after 14 passes, a cycle of length 2, -4548 and 9907 at the Node [95, 0, 0] of the row 2'; the advisor's hand of 2026-10-02 (#1563 comment 5946604467, section 4) finds no integers that obey the line at this look's coupling, so the look's re-design with a small charge on a neutral body is a later round. Nothing tuned.
reading: per world the centroid of each body's share over its half of the chain (the share in the current's units at the paces of the read, exact fractions; a single body's over the whole chain), the separation (the second less the first) at the window's ends and its change; the background the uncharged pair's change plus the image force of the faces read on the single bodies, the charged singles' separation change (the second's drift less the first's) less the uncharged singles'; like and unlike read against it: a = like's change less the background, b = unlike's change less the background

blind.image: both charged pairs end further apart than the uncharged pair by the image force, each charged body drawn to its nearer face by its own tent (a grounded wall, the face reading 0), the same force on a charged single body against an uncharged one, a reading beside the blind; the forces adding is what the blind's three lines test
blind.size: the same size to the lattice's precision: |a + b| at most a third of (a - b) / 2, the second order of the angle (the like world's deeper level and the unlike world's cancelled one shift the two bodies' rotations differently, and the holder's own angle at a body, a twentieth of its binding margin omega_0 - omega_b at the level weight 100) and the lays' rounding; a larger asymmetry is a finding by name, never smoothed
blind.plain: the control, the act pace: the holder's level is a hollow whatever the reader's sense (ALGEBRA.md (f)), so like_plain's bodies are drawn to each other's positive level and its separation closes faster than neutral's, while unlike_plain's first body is pushed from the second's negative level and the second drawn to the first's positive one, both drifting the same way, its separation near neutral's to the first order
blind.first_order: GameBoard, the ray's estimate from the law's lines: the holder's rest on an open chain of N Nodes is a tent with the slope 3 sigma (x_s + 1) / (N + 1) beyond its source at x_s, sigma the source's levels per interval (the body's W div T over the level weight, about 50 quanta x 1 / (2 sin omega_0) / 100 = 0.34 levels per interval, the tent building up over the run inside the bodies' wells); the second body's ray reads the angle's gradient as dk per interval = (dL / dx) / Gamma and moves at v = (num / (3 den)) k / sin omega_0, so its centroid drifts by about a half of (num / (3 den sin omega_0)) (dL / dx) / Gamma x T^2 Links over T intervals: with the slope about 0.25 of a level per Link, about 1.0 Links each way over 400 intervals, the separation changing by about 2.0 Links against the neutral world's, a bound body answering a gradient as a free packet does to within a tenth; the background holds the mutual pull of the binding holder and gravity (the uncharged pair's) and the image force of the faces (the single bodies'), each body's own spreading in both
blind.derivation: the sign, by the ray (WKB) of the law's line and the engine's convention of the turn: the step e^(i theta) z_next + e^(-i theta) z_before = M z_now with theta = L / Gamma turns the plane against the sense of the record of positive Wronskian (z_before = z_now e^(i omega), clockwise), so that record's rotation rate is omega + theta where L > 0 and the record of negative W's is omega - theta; a ray at the wave number k has the rotation rate phi(k, x) = omega(k) + theta(x) for the positive record and dk / dt = -d phi / dx = -(dL / dx) / Gamma, so it accelerates down the level: a body of positive W sources L > 0 about itself (the write (w W + r) div (E_s T), the start's rest of the sources' sign), the other positive body is pushed away and a negative one (whose rate is omega - theta) is pulled in: like apart, unlike together, the same size, (f)'s words. The law's line as written, e^(-i theta) z_next + e^(i theta) z_before, with the same W convention (ALGEBRA.md, +A^2 sin omega for e^(-i omega t)) gives the positive record omega - theta and like senses together; the engine builds the sign (f) names and ENGINE.md states the convention
blind.status: computed from the law's lines (the ray's first order), the sign the engine's declared convention of the turn
blind.fence: GameBoard: the drift of a share's centroid is a reading of the record, no click; the clicks that tell like from unlike are the bodies' round's (ALGEBRA.md (f))
